list.title: Flows
list.subtitle: Build branching, button-driven WhatsApp conversations. Useful for menus, FAQs, and triage before a human steps in.
list.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? Any active runs will end immediately.
list.createSubtitle: Start from a template or build from scratch.
list.emptyBody: Build your first conversation — a welcome menu, an order lookup, an FAQ bot. Customers tap buttons; the bot routes them to the right answer (or the right agent).

trigger.firstInbound: Triggers on a contact's first-ever inbound message

welcome_menu.name: Welcome menu
welcome_menu.description: Greet customers who type a keyword and route them to the right agent based on whether they're new or existing.

faq_bot.name: FAQ bot
faq_bot.description: Answer common questions automatically. Customer picks a topic from a list; the bot replies with the answer and ends.

lead_capture.name: Lead capture
lead_capture.description: Greet first-time inbounds, capture name + email + company, then hand off to sales with the answers in the note.

runs.title: Runs
runs.subtitle: The 50 most recent times this flow ran. Expand a row to see the engine's per-step log.
runs.empty: No runs yet. Trigger the flow from a personal WhatsApp number to see it appear here.
runs.noEvents: No events recorded for this run.

nodeDesc.send_buttons: Message with up to 3 reply buttons
nodeDesc.collect_input: Ask a question and store the answer
nodeDesc.condition: Branch based on a variable or tag
nodeDesc.set_tag: Add or remove a contact tag
nodeDesc.handoff_ai_agent: Let an AI agent take over the conversation
nodeDesc.book_appointment: The customer books by tapping day and time (no AI)

toast.fixBeforeActivate: Fix the issues below before activating.
toast.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? Any active runs end immediately. This can't be undone.

header.unsavedTitle: Unsaved changes — hit Save to persist
header.fixBeforeActivate: Fix the issues below before activating
header.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional description (internal — customers don't see this)

form.varKey: Variable key (stored in flow_runs.vars; alphanumeric + underscore)
form.interpolateHint: Interpolate in downstream prompts and handoff notes with
form.handoffNote: Internal note (for the agent picking up)
form.endHelp: Terminal node. When the runner reaches this node the run is marked complete. No config needed.
form.nodeKey: Node key (internal identifier — keep stable for analytics)
form.replyIdsHelp: Reply IDs for each option are shown inline above. They're returned by WhatsApp when a customer taps; you usually don't need to touch them.
form.optionsLabel: Options (1–{max}) — each one routes to a different next node
form.buttonsLabel: Buttons (1–3) — each one routes to a different next node

issues.entryRequired: Pick an entry node before activating.
issues.noNodes: A flow needs at least one node before activation.
issues.unreachable: Node "{key}" is unreachable from the entry node.
issues.noKeywords: Keyword triggers need at least one keyword.
issues.blankKeyword: 1 keyword is blank — it won't match anything.
issues.blankKeywords: {count} keywords are blank — they won't match anything.
issues.needsText: This node needs a text body.
issues.needsNext: This node must point to a next node.
issues.needsButton: Send-buttons needs at least one button.
issues.tooManyOptions: A numbered menu allows at most {max} options.
issues.tooManyButtons: WhatsApp allows at most {max} buttons per message. Switch to a numbered menu for more.
issues.buttonTitleTooLong: Button {n} title is over {max} chars (WhatsApp limit).
issues.listNeedsLabel: Send-list needs a button label (the tap-to-expand text).
issues.listNeedsRow: Send-list needs at least one row.
issues.listTooManyRows: Send-list allows at most {max} rows total across sections.
issues.rowNeedsId: Row {n} in section {section} needs a reply id.
issues.inputNeedsPrompt: Collect-input needs a prompt to send the customer.
issues.inputNeedsVar: Collect-input needs a var_key to store the answer under.
issues.inputBadVar: var_key "{key}" must be alphanumeric+underscore and start with a letter or underscore.
issues.conditionNeedsSubject: Condition needs a subject (var / tag / contact_field).
issues.conditionNeedsKey: Condition needs a subject_key (var name, tag id, or field name).
issues.conditionEmptyValueEquals: Operator "equals" usually expects a comparison value — empty value will only match empty subjects.
issues.conditionEmptyValueContains: Operator "contains" usually expects a comparison value — empty value will only match empty subjects.
issues.conditionNeedsTrue: Condition needs a node for the "true" branch.
issues.conditionNeedsFalse: Condition needs a node for the "false" branch.
issues.tagNeedsMode: Set-tag needs a mode (add or remove).
issues.tagNeedsTag: Set-tag needs a tag to apply.
issues.aiNeedsAgent: Hand-off-to-AI node needs an AI agent.
issues.aiAgentGone: The selected AI agent no longer exists or is disabled.
issues.bookNeedsBooked: Book-appointment needs a next node for "booked".
issues.bookNeedsLink: Book-appointment needs a next node for "link sent".
issues.bookNeedsNotBooked: Book-appointment needs a next node for "not booked".
